verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers indexing, search UI, CLI, analytics, and Agent Studio, but contains no documentation on data retention policies, record/index deletion guarantees, GDPR/right-to-be-forgotten mechanisms, or data lifecycle controls for AI-native privacy needs. While Algolia's API can manage/delete records (algolia-docs-4), there is no evidence of explicit retention-period settings or deletion audit/compliance tooling.
